groups.prompt: Resolve each supplied funnel stage input independently. Return cases A onward in input order. For each case return ledger rows with the requested identity, timestamps, booleans, money, and truth fields, preserving row order, nulls, false values, and exact numbers. Return JSON only.

Reconcile each supplied funnel cost input independently. Return cases A onward in input order. For each case return the requested report rows and undated-row count, preserving row order, nulls, false values, and exact numbers. Return JSON only.

Plan each supplied partition refresh independently. Return cases A onward in input order. For each case return the requested refresh fields, target partitions, and replacement rows, preserving array order, nulls, false values, and exact timestamps and numbers. Return JSON only.
